correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated the cube Q3 twelve graph edges and all matching faces, obtaining f=(12,42,44,9), total 107. Replayed the prescribed sequential 51-pair discrete-Morse matching on all nonempty faces and checked the full directed Hasse graph is acyclic; one critical point and four critical 2-simplices remain. With no positive-dimensional lower critical cells, the CW model is precisely 4 wedged S^2. The bundled checker also confirms augmented mod-2 boundary ranks (1,11,31,9), but those ranks alone are not used to infer homotopy.

value.rationale: The 3-cube is the first genuinely three-direction hypercube, naturally distinct from two-row planar grid graph families. The exact integral homotopy of its ordinary matching complex is a finite but canonical graph invariant and a meaningful base case for cube/hypercube or line-graph topological studies; no family recurrence is claimed. Its exhaustive proof is not itself the value justification.
